must_mention_risks.text: The code uploads with ACL='public-read'; Cloud Storage uses uniform bucket-level access, so per-object ACLs must be replaced by IAM or signed URLs
The API is defined by swagger.yaml for API Gateway and must be re-expressed as an API Gateway (OpenAPI) config or Cloud Run ingress
DynamoDB single-key access (fromNumber) must be re-modelled for Firestore or Bigtable
boto3 and the Twilio client code must be ported to Google Cloud client libraries; Twilio keys must move to Secret Manager
